item.title: They signed up for a lifetime at sea on an endless cruise. High gas prices intervened
item.description: A cruise ship suspended operations suddenly, citing soaring fuel costs. Passengers, including Randy Cassingham, had to disembark in Cambodia. NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to Cassingham about the ordeal.
item.dc:creator: Ayesha Rascoe

item.title: Secretary Rubio has a tough time getting officials at G20 on the same page
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is hosting the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta, with a focus on economic and security challenges.
item.dc:creator: Michele Kelemen
